C1437.title: EIP-1559 Base Fee Manipulation Attack Research
C1437.summary: Academic research reveals that Ethereum's EIP-1559 transaction fee mechanism, under the conservative assumption of a stable demand curve, is susceptible to manipulation by a small group of attackers, such as miners with 20% of the hash power.
